prior_failures_and_resolution: Source suite initially had a hardcoded 57-operation expectation; updated for the single GET-only event route. Final 494 passed.
MCP schema comparison initially used an export generated with the coordinator Pydantic environment. Re-exported with source environment; final 56 passed.
Full coordinator suite first reported 830 passes and two older Quality snapshot fixture failures. Optional autonomous-quality view now tolerates absent fields; focused Quality corpus passed.
New restart probe exposed a misleading stopped/interrupted status while hardening cancellation; preserved persisted restart failure and derived stopped state separately. Focused regression passed.

Browser integration revealed selected-persona reset behavior and a host-poll cleanup bug at completion; scoped autonomous reset now preserves persona, full reset still signs out, and poll lifetime no longer invalidates workspace reads.
Overview QE-011 initially fell through to DR-009 quantity copy; explicit quality case mapping now uses its own 100 held / 100 gap source context.
Mobile reset-scope text overflow corrected with concise scope label and constrained control width; full reset browser passed.
Two concurrently launched browser suites collided in default trace output storage. Unique output directories now isolate artifacts; both suites passed.
One final browser invocation used repository cwd for screenshots; known generated images were moved into the repository and the test now resolves its screenshot directory from the spec file.
